Subject: Late Check-in Inquiry – Reservation HTN789 (April 10–12)

Dear Front Desk Team,

I have a reservation at your hotel for **April 10–12, 2026**, confirmation number **HTN789**. I wanted to inform you that I may need to check in later than standard hours due to my flight arrival time. 

Could you please confirm:
- Your latest check-in time
- Any procedures for late arrivals
- Whether my reservation will be held if I arrive after standard check-in hours

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards  
Alice Chen
